chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa al-Daqqaq (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: Musa ibn Imran narrated to us, from al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, from Thabit ibn Dinar, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said: Yazid ibn Qa'nab said:

I was sitting with al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib and a group from the tribe of Abd al-Uzza near the Sacred House of Allah, when Fatima bint Asad, the mother of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), approached. She was nine months pregnant and had been overtaken by labor pains. She said: My Lord! Indeed, I am a believer in You and in what has come from You of messengers and books. And I believe in the words of my grandfather Ibrahim the Friend (peace be upon him), and that he built the Ancient House. So by the right of the One who built this House, and by the right of the child in my womb, make my delivery easy for me.

Yazid ibn Qa'nab said: We saw the House open from its back, and Fatima entered it and disappeared from our sight, and the wall sealed itself. We tried to open the lock of the door but it would not open. So we knew that this was a matter from the command of Allah, Mighty and Majestic. Then she came out after the fourth day, and in her hand was the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him).

Then she said: I have been given excellence over the women who came before me, because Asiya bint Muzahim worshipped Allah, Mighty and Majestic, in secret in a place where Allah does not like to be worshipped except out of necessity. And Maryam bint Imran shook the dried date palm with her hand until she ate fresh ripe dates from it. But I entered the Sacred House of Allah and ate from the fruits of Paradise and its sustenance.

When I wanted to come out, a caller called out to me: O Fatima! Name him Ali, for he is Ali, and Allah, the Most High, the Supreme, says: I have derived his name from My name, and I have trained him with My discipline, and I have made him privy to the depths of My knowledge. He is the one who will break the idols in My House, and he is the one who will call the adhan from atop My House, and he will glorify Me and exalt Me. So glad tidings to the one who loves him and obeys him, and woe to the one who hates him and disobeys him.

key_terms.الكعبة: The Ka'ba - the sacred cubic structure in Mecca, the holiest site in Islam, toward which Muslims pray
key_terms.علي بن أبي طالب: Ali ibn Abi Talib - the first Imam of Shia Islam, cousin and son-in-law of the Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.فاطمة بنت أسد: Fatima bint Asad - mother of Imam Ali and wife of Abu Talib, uncle of the Prophet Muhammad
key_terms.قريش: Quraysh - the dominant tribe of Mecca to which the Prophet Muhammad and Imam Ali belonged

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about Imam Ali being born inside the Ka'ba?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the miraculous birth of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) inside the Ka'ba. Yazid ibn Qa'nab reports that Fatima bint Asad, the mother of Ali, went into labor at the Ka'ba. As she leaned against its wall in prayer, the wall miraculously split open and she entered the sacred house, where she remained for three days. She emerged carrying baby Ali in her arms. This event was witnessed by members of the Quraysh and the people of Mecca, and it is considered one of the unique honors bestowed upon Imam Ali. The narrator Sa'id ibn Jubayr adds that this privilege was not granted to anyone before or after him. The hadith is transmitted through a chain of narrators going back to al-Mufaddal ibn Umar from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. Ahmad b. Musa al-Daqqaq (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ja`far al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: Musa b. `Imran narrated to us from al-Husayn b. Yazid from Muhammad b. Sinan from al Mufaddal b. `Umar from Thabit b. Dinar from Sa`id b. Jubayr.  He said: Yazid b. Qa`nab said:

I was sitting with al-`Abbas b. `Abd al-Muttalib and a party of the tribe of `Abd al `Uzza were near the Sacred House of Allah when Fatima bt. Asad, the mother of Amir al-Mu’minin (as), who was nine months pregnant and overtaken by labour pains, approached. She said: My Lord! Surely, I am a believer in You and in what has come from You of the messengers and the books. And I am a believer in the word of my grandfather, Ibrahim the Friend (as), who laid the foundation of the Ancient House. So, for the sake of the one who laid the foundation of this House and for the sake of the child who is in my womb, with whom I have come to You, facilitate my delivery for me.

Yazid b. Qa`nab said: We saw the House open at its back and Fatima enter therein and disappear from our sight, and the wall came together [again]. We tried to get the lock of the door to open for us, but it did not open. So, we knew that the decree was from Allah’s command.

Then, she came out after four days, and in her hand was Amir al-Mu’minin (as). And she said: I have excellence over all the women who have preceded me because Asiya bint Muzahim worshipped Allah in secret in a place where it is not liked that Allah be worshipped therein save under compulsion. And Maryam bint `Imran had to shake the dried date palm until she ate ripe fruits from it, while I entered the Sacred House of Allah and ate from the dates of Paradise and its sustenance.

When I desired to come out, a crier called out to me: “O Fatima! Name him `Ali, for he is `Ali and Allah is al-`Ali (the High) al-A`la (the Most High). He (Allah) says: I have split his name from Mine and trained him Myself and made him fit for the mystery of My knowledge and he is the one who will break the idols in My House and he is the one who will call towards prayer on top of My House. He will glorify Me and he will exalt me. So, glad tidings to the one who loves him and obeys him; and woe to the one who holds malice for him and disobeys him.
